jobs.title: Full Stack Developer – Treasury Technology
jobs.description:
Full Stack Developer – Treasury Technology

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
Core to the health and growth of Millennium’s business, the Information Technology organization develops flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including next-generation analytical and trading capabilities. Within this organization, the Treasury Technology team develops systems used by Treasury, Counterparty Risk, and Treasury Operations teams across the firm. Its platforms support Margin, Cash and Collateral Management, Treasury Operations, and Equity Finance for Treasury analysts, Front Office users, Portfolio Managers, and Senior Management.

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with business stakeholders globally to understand business needs, define requirements, and deliver effective technology solutions
* Develop and enhance Treasury applications that support critical Treasury, Counterparty Risk, and Treasury Operations processes
* Own delivery timelines for Treasury applications and projects, coordinating priorities and dependencies across a global technology organization
* Take end-to-end ownership of software systems throughout the application lifecycle, from design and development through deployment and ongoing support
* Apply sound engineering practices to solve complex business problems in a fast-paced environment

**What You Bring**

* At least five years of hands-on programming experience, with a strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, service-oriented architecture, concurrency, and SOLID principles
* Hands-on .NET development experience, including C# and ASP.NET Web API
* Experience building web applications using Angular, Ember.js, or similar frameworks
* Experience working with AWS or other cloud technologies
* Recent experience owning one or more large software systems and managing the full application lifecycle
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently and deliver in a dynamic environment
* Experience with enterprise databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Sybase, or Oracle, as well as continuous delivery tools
* Familiarity with capital markets concepts and operational structures; experience with Kubernetes, Kafka, and Python is a plus

jobs.title: Backend .NET Developer
jobs.description:
**Creatio is a global vendor of an agentic CRM & workflow platform with no-code and AI at its core.** We help organizations automate customer and operational workflows achieving the fastest time-to-value and the highest ROI on the market. Millions of workflows run on Creatio daily, supporting thousands of clients in over 100 countries. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA.

We’re proud to be recognized by top industry analysts as a **Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports.**

**In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list,** recognizing our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture.

### **Who We’re Looking For:**

We are seeking an innovative **Backend .NET Developer** to join our **Core Domain** for collaborating within Scrum teams. As a Software Developer at Creatio, you will contribute to the core business process platform, delivering scalable and customizable solutions that empower organizations to automate workflows and drive innovation.

Our teams are focused on the using best engineering practices. We provide the AI SDLC for all our engineering teams and have a wide range of AI practices in use.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Designing, coding, testing, and debugging software according to specifications and requirements.
* Transforming the system design into actual software by writing code and implementing features.
* Collaborating with stakeholders and product managers.
* Conducting unit tests, integration tests, and system tests.
* Participating in scrum team activities.

### **Requirements:**

* Confident in C# and .NET 8+.
* Strong knowledge of OOP and principles like KISS, SOLID, DRY.
* Hands-on experience with ASP.NET MVC/Core, Entity Framework and building Web APIs.
* Experience with Git, including branching, merging, and rebasing.
* Familiar with unit testing and mocking (NUnit, Mock). and API testing (Postman).
* Experience working with databases (MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
* Experience with AI technologies and solutions is a plus, but not required.
* English level — Upper-Intermediate (spoken and business writing) or higher.

### **What you should expect from us:**

* **Growth & Development:** Clear career paths, mentorship opportunities, and access to continuous learning to help you reach your full potential.
* **Flexibility & Well-Being**: We provide flexible work arrangements and initiatives that empower you to manage your schedule effectively, stay productive, and thrive both personally and professionally.
* **Recognition & Impact:** A culture that celebrates achievements, values your ideas, and empowers you to make real contributions from day one.
* **Innovative Culture:** Be part of a company that embraces new ideas, modern technologies, and bold thinking to stay ahead of the curve.
* **Benefits & Rewards Package**: We provide competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you and your family. Our rewards approach goes beyond salary, recognizing your contributions and commitment. The exact package may vary depending on your country of residence and employment type.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Using AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while critically reviewing code for quality, security and correctness.
* Collaborating with testers and DevOps, contributing to sprint planning, and helping solve support issues at the root cause.

#LI-AT2

* 3+ years of software development experience.
* Strong experience with Microsoft .NET / C#.

* Exposure to web UI development such as React, Angular or jQuery.
* Confidence using AI-assisted coding tools with a critical eye on output quality and security.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach.

  

**Why join us**

* Remote role based in Poland.
* Lublin office available if you’d like to work from there - but it’s not a requirement.

* Opportunity to work in a specialist pharmaceutical technology space with plenty of room to learn and grow.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Platform)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Why A365 Software Engineering?**  
  
Build the cloud platform that’s transforming electronics design. Altium 365 for cloud lets design engineers communicate, collaborate and bring their ideas to market more efficiently than any platform in the industry. These are some of the R&D Software Engineering contributions you might make to Altium 365:

* Building new cloud-native applications and scalable infrastructure
* Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities
* Large-scale data processing; data modelling; holistic, intent-based API design
* Stateful and stateless servers, relational databases, ORM frameworks

Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.  
  
**A day in the Life of our** **Senior Software Engineer**  
Your primary role will be product development for complex cloud applications with the Altium 365 Platform team.  
  
**Technologies We Use**

* .NET Core, .NET Framework 4.8., MySQL
* AWS cloud
* Microservices
* GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes.

There are 100+ services in the product.

 **Qualifications**

**What We're looking for**

* 7+ years of .NET experience
* Deep expertise in one or more of these areas:  
  identity and authentication, access or license management, message queues/brokers,  
  distributed caches, ElasticSearch/OpenSearch, relational database design and optimization,  
  platform framework development, multi-tenancy, Rings Protection Model in cloud development
* Proven experience building and operating distributed, high-load systems, including performance profiling, optimisation, load testing, and stress testing
* Strong ability to solve complex technical challenges that differ from typical market products, combining engineering software and cloud services
* Ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and drive architectural decisions
* Experience defining and driving engineering standards, best practices, and technical governance at a platform level

**Nice to have**

* Firebird, Oracle, Postgres.
* Azure/GCP/AliCloud

  
**Additional Information**  

* Altium’s Website ( http://altium.com )
* Altium Customer Stories ( https://www.youtube.com/@AltiumStories )

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.
